page_title: Aident Loadout | Apps for AI Agents

sources.entry: Aident Loadout - Connects Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP clients to your apps and 400+ expert-built Skills through one remote MCP server, CLI or Skill, with credentials kept in a vault and every action logged. #freemium #mcp

summary.name: Aident Loadout
summary.one_liner: Aident Loadout is a capability layer that connects AI agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor to third-party Apps, Actions and expert-built Skills through one reusable setup.
keywords: give ai agent access to apps
pay as you go ai tools
use_cases: Connect Claude Code or Codex to Gmail, CRM or issue trackers
Reuse one app setup across multiple coding agents
Run prebuilt research, outreach or ops workflows as agent skills
Review and audit what actions an AI agent performed
Keep API keys and OAuth credentials away from the agent
summary.what_it_does: Aident Loadout exposes connected Apps to AI agents through one remote MCP server, a CLI, or a Skill, according to the page. The page cites 27,000+ Actions across Apps and over 400 expert-built Skills for research, outreach, content and operations. OAuth connections are authorized in the browser, while API keys and delegated credentials are stored in Aident Vault so agents receive action results rather than raw provider credentials. An Audit view records what ran, whether it succeeded and what it cost. The page lists compatibility with Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, HermesAgent, ChatGPT, Claude Desktop and other MCP-compatible clients.
notable: One remote MCP server, CLI or Skill connects Apps to many agents
Credentials kept in Aident Vault; agents receive results, not raw keys
Audit log of every Action with source, outcome and cost
caveats: Some Apps require your own OAuth account or a Vault credential rather than Aident-managed access
Usage is funded by a USD balance; Pro and Team plans offer higher limits, and exact prices are on a separate pricing page not shown here
Free credits are limited to 20 at signup and up to 100 after onboarding
